query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# Decides whether a pull request or a push touches anything but docs. Called as the `changes`
# job by specs.yml: docs-only changes skip the heavy jobs, while the CI Success job still runs
# and reports success. README.md, CHANGELOG.md and LICENSE ship in the gem and
# built_gem_spec.rb checks that they exist, so only a modification of them counts as docs

name: CI Changes

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      code:
        description: "'false' when the heavy jobs can be skipped, 'true' otherwise"
        value: ${{ jobs.detect.outputs.code }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  detect:
    timeout-minutes: 5
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      code: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.code }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          # A push compares against its `before` commit, which needs the history
          fetch-depth: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && 0 || 2 }}

      - name: Detect code changes
        id: filter
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: |
          # code=true runs everything; anything unexpected (a git error too) gives code=true
          set -uo pipefail
          out() {
            echo "code=$1 ($2)"
            echo "code=$1" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          }

          case "$EVENT_NAME" in
            pull_request)
              # HEAD is the PR merge commit, so HEAD^1..HEAD is what the PR changes in main
              base="HEAD^1"
              ;;
            push)
              # A new branch has no `before`; a force push may not descend from it
              case "$BEFORE" in
                ''|0000000000000000000000000000000000000000) out true "new branch" ;;
              esac
              git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BEFORE" HEAD 2>/dev/null ||
                out true "$BEFORE is not an ancestor of HEAD"
              base="$BEFORE"
              ;;
            *)
              out true "event $EVENT_NAME"
              ;;
          esac

          changed="$(git diff --name-status --no-renames "$base" HEAD)" || out true "git diff failed"
          [ -n "$changed" ] || out true "empty diff"

          echo "Changed files:"
          echo "$changed"

          while IFS=$'\t' read -r status file; do
            case "$file" in
              README.md|CHANGELOG.md|LICENSE)
                [ "$status" = "M" ] || out true "$status $file"
                ;;
              lib/*|spec/*|test/*|bin/*|examples/*|rubocop/*|test_workers/*)
                out true "$file"
                ;;
              .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*|.github/FUNDING.yml)
                ;;
              *.md|LICENSE*)
                # Docs in a top-level directory that holds Ruby code count as code
                if [ "$file" != "${file#*/}" ]; then
                  tree="$(git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- "${file%%/*}/")" || out true "git ls-tree failed"
                  ! grep -q '\.rb$' <<< "$tree" || out true "$file"
                fi
                ;;
              *.png|*.jpg|*.jpeg|*.svg|*.gif)
                ;;
              *)
                out true "$file"
                ;;
            esac
          done <<< "$changed"

          out false "docs only"

results.content:
Skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

Reported metrics: {"comparison": "less_than", "paid_vm_time_reduction_upper_bound_percent": 0.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.4; Table 4; PDF pp. 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

results.content:
Cancel superseded runs

Pattern: P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (stale_run_cancellation)

When is cancel superseded runs applicable?

Assess cancel superseded runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Runs represent the same workflow and branch or PR; A newer revision supersedes older checks

Contraindications: Release or deployment work; Distinct branches share a cancellation group

Method: Partition cancellation by workflow and branch/PR; Preserve run identity and audit records

Reported finding: Superseding runs can reduce duplicate work.

Reported metrics: {"vm_time_reduction_percent": {"free": 1.9, "paid": 4.1}}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.3; Table 4; PDF pp. 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
finish every revision's CI run


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
cancel an older run only when a newer run supersedes it

+cancel an older run only when a newer run supersedes it

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
